changelog:
- Initial public release of Fairy Team Skills, a multi-agent collaboration skill pack in Zenless Zone Zero style.
- Includes 5 character skill cards and 23 practical skills, each with real-world validation and code examples.
- Designed for game development, multi-agent system project management, and team onboarding.
- Features skills across architecture, PM, design, development, and planning disciplines.
- Originates from hands-on experience revamping game projects and agent collaboration.
